title: Winnowing: Local Algorithms for Document Fingerprinting
venue: ACM SIGMOD International Conference on Management of Data
core_finding: Fingerprinting guarantees detection of shared substrings of length >= (w + k - 1) via minimum hash selection in sliding windows.
codebase_implication: N-gram breaking rules must alter word sequences cleanly at clause boundaries without dissecting compound technical terms.

title: BERTScore: Evaluating Text Generation with BERT
core_finding: Contextual token embeddings capture semantic similarity better than n-gram overlap, but can be insensitive to negation and numerical flips.
codebase_implication: Evaluation must combine semantic embeddings with deterministic symbolic assertion checks for numbers, negations, and entities.

title: GPT detectors are biased against non-native English writers
core_finding: Detectors evaluate perplexity and burstiness, systematically misclassifying non-native English writing as AI-generated (>61% false positive rate).
codebase_implication: Do not optimize text transformation to game detector perplexity by adding archaic words; prioritize genuine natural human clarity.

title: Detecting ChatGPT-generated essays in a large-scale writing assessment: Is there a bias against non-native English speakers?
core_finding: Confirms detector bias against standard vocabulary and shows that ornamental vocabulary substitutions harm communicative competence.
codebase_implication: Avoid arbitrary injections of decorative transitions or hedges into text.

title: On Faithfulness and Factuality in Abstractive Summarization
core_finding: Extrinsic hallucination occurs when models add non-asserted claims; intrinsic hallucination occurs when source facts are distorted.
codebase_implication: Eliminate arbitrary appositives that add unverified encyclopedic definitions to scientific text.

title: Evaluating the Factual Consistency of Abstractive Text Summarization
venue: Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP)
core_finding: Entity and numerical quantity errors represent the majority of factual failures in automated rewriting.
codebase_implication: Lock numerical values and proper names before transformation and verify exact 100% presence afterwards.

title: The Science of Scientific Writing
core_finding: Scientific clarity requires active verbs expressing core actions; excessive nominalization obscures agency and blurs causal relationships.
codebase_implication: Disable blind nominalization by default in academic and technical processing modes.

title: The Czech Digital Mathematics Library: Processing of Mathematics in LaTeX
core_finding: Nested LaTeX expressions require balanced bracket/brace stack parsing rather than single-level regular expressions.
codebase_implication: Implement a balanced-brace stack parser for LaTeX environments, commands, and math blocks.

title: Terminological Mappings and Multi-Word Units: Quantitative and Qualitative Aspects
core_finding: Multi-word technical units are non-compositional semantic atoms; inserting modifiers inside an MWU breaks semantic reference.
codebase_implication: Protect multi-word technical units (e.g., 'learning rate', 'gradient descent') against word insertion.
